resources.string: Timahilin n tebdart n uraǧu d uzuɣer yernan deg lqem-a
Asiti ɣef tmwalit yesseɣray-itt yal tikkelt
Bdu taɣuri mi ara teldiḍ tamwalit, ula ma taɣuri tawurmant tettwasbadu i Wi-Fi kan neɣ tensa. Taɣuri tawurmant tettkemmil ad tettwasnes ɣef yibdayen iwurmanen
Suter asentem send ad tsefḍeḍ tabdart n uraǧu
Aɛeddi seg yiwen umeɣri ɣer wayeḍ yezmer ad ibeddel tabdart-ik n uraǧu
Tabdart n uraǧu n umeɣri urmid ad tettwabeddel
Rmed tigawin n uzuɣer ɣef tmwaliyin
Zuɣer tamwalit ɣer zelmeḍ neɣ ɣer yefus deg usebter agejdan, igmaḍ n unadi, tibdarin n tɣuri d trebbaɛ n yibuda i usekker n tigawt tarurant

Azuɣer yesra izirigen s tehri merra akken ad iteddu akken iwata, ihi askan n tebdart ad yettwaseqdec deg wadeg n uskan n yiẓiki neɣ n tkarḍiwin anda llant tigawin n uzuɣer. Tzemreḍ ad t-tsenseḍ tikkelt nniḍen melmi tebɣiḍ.
Yensa mi ara rmedent tigawin n uzuɣer, acku ḥettment askan n tebdart
Kkes seg tebdart n tɣuri (tibdarin n tɣuri kan)
Ad tessidreḍ syin ad tesbeddeḍ aleqqem-a? Android ad ak-d-yessuter ad tesnetmeḍ asebded.
Asider ur yeddi ara. Senqed tuqqna-k syin ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
Lqem-a ur yezmir ara ad isbedd aleqqem s yiman-is, amedya acku d lqem n tseɣtayt. Sider APK seg usebter n lqem deg wadeg-is.
Aleqqem ur yezmir ara ad yettwasbedd: %s

Sken tibdarin n uraǧu i tesseɣraḍ ddaw Tibdarin n tɣuri, akken ad tkemmleḍ fell-asent neɣ ad tent-tsekklseḍ ticki. Timwaliyin i ternuḍ ɣer tebdart n uraǧu i yebdan seg yiwet seg tebdarin-ik n tɣuri ad ttwarnunt ɣer tebdart-nni. Tibdarin n uraǧu n tebdarin n tɣuri d yibuda n YouTube ur ttwaḥerzent ara
